elements.description: Grouped vertical bar chart. Y-axis: "Percent of gross domestic income (%)", scale 0 to 10 with gridlines at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. X-axis categories: Vietnam, Mongolia, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines. Legend: Earnings loss (teal), Support to households (orange). No values are printed on the bars; approximate readings: Vietnam earnings loss ~2.8, support ~0.9; Mongolia earnings loss ~3.0, support ~9.4; Thailand earnings loss ~3.4, support ~3.6; Malaysia earnings loss ~4.1, support ~2.4; Indonesia earnings loss ~5.4, support ~1.9; Philippines earnings loss ~8.6, support ~1.9. Source noted as World Bank 2021c. Mongolia shows the largest support bar, while the Philippines has the largest earnings loss; support is well below losses in most countries except Mongolia and Thailand, where it is roughly equal or higher.
